messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Portuguese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Portuguese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
assim meu espírito que ainda fugia, virou‑se para trás para observar o passo que nunca deixou pessoa viva.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table (source → Portuguese)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | così | resultative adverb “so” | assim | “so / thus” | OK | | l'animo | “the soul” (subject) | espírito | “spirit / soul” | OK | | mio | possessive “my” | meu | “my” | OK | | ch'ancor | relative “which still” | que ainda | “that still” | OK | | fuggiva | imperfect “was fleeing” | fugia | “was fleeing” | OK | | si | reflexive clitic (self) | ‑se (part of *virou‑se*) | “‑self” | OK | | volse | past “turned” | virou | “turned” | OK | | a (1) | preposition of direction “to” (in *a retro*) | para | “to / toward” | OK | | retro | noun used adverbially “back” | trás | “back” | OK | | a (2) | preposition introducing infinitive “to” | para | “to” | OK | | rimirar | infinitive “to look again” | observar | “to observe / look at” | OK | | lo | definite article “the” | o | “the” | OK | | passo | “pass” (object) | passo | “pass” | OK | | che | relative “which / that” | que | “that / which” | OK | | non | negation “never” | nunca | “never” | OK | | lasciò | past “left” | deixou | “left / abandoned” | OK | | già | temporal adverb “already” | — (omitted) | “already” | **MISSING** | | mai | intensifier “never” (redundant with *non*) | — (omitted) | “never” | **UNNECESSARY** | | persona | “person” (human) | pessoa | “person” | **GRAMMAR** (article omitted) | | viva | adjective “living” | viva | “living” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **MISSING:** *già* – the Portuguese translation lacks the adverb “já” (“already”). - **UNNECESSARY:** *mai* – Portuguese expresses the double negation with a single *nunca*, making *mai* redundant. - **GRAMMAR:** *persona* → *pessoa* – Portuguese normally requires an article (*uma pessoa viva*); the translation omits it, which is a minor grammatical omission.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Portuguese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Portuguese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 25** - Original: assim meu espírito que ainda fugia, - Issue: none - Corrected: assim meu espírito que ainda fugia,
- **Line 26** - Original: virou‑se para trás para observar o passo - Issue: none - Corrected: virou‑se para trás para observar o passo
- **Line 27** - Original: que nunca deixou pessoa viva. - Issue: missing “já” (MISSING) - Corrected: que já nunca deixou pessoa viva.
``` assim meu espírito que ainda fugia, virou‑se para trás para observar o passo que já nunca deixou pessoa viva. ```
